docs.description: Panel that slides in from the viewport edge for a secondary task that keeps the page in context — filters, quick edits, settings. Single variant; title is a text prop, content is a slot, hasCTA toggles the footer Button Group. Traps focus like a dialog; Esc closes and focus returns to the trigger. Use Dialog when the task must finish before the page continues; use Detail Side Panel for read-only detail.

rules.reason: A panel that slides in from the viewport's edge for a secondary task that keeps the page in context, as the description says: its title and close button, the caller's content, and an optional footer (a Button Group). It traps the focus as a dialog does, Escape closing it and the focus returning to its trigger, over the Scrim. MUI's Drawer on the web, anchored at the end edge; in Flutter the panel is a widget (SolarDrawer), shown by showSolarDrawer or as a Scaffold's end drawer. Drawn in place where the caller asks (`inline`).
